instructions.text: To create a note, select its intended folder, then choose New Note. The first line becomes its title; Notes saves edits automatically.
To edit an existing note, open or search for it first. The note list selects documents; the note body is the text editor.
After creating or opening the note, select its editable body. Reuse exact supplied or remembered text; use compose when new prose is needed. Verify the body contains the intended content.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Workflow guidance from the distinction between document selection and editing; not yet live-tested.

instructions.text: For a transfer to another app, remember or copy the completed note body before switching. Keep that exact text for the destination so the writing helper does not produce a different version.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick has remember, copy_text, fill, and compose actions; this is a proposed cross-app workflow.

instructions.text: If typing changes search text or a note title instead of the body, observe again and select the body. If the body is absent, inspect the current window or use the available screen scan.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Recovery guidance for incomplete Accessibility observations; not a fixed selector or screen position.

instructions.text: Treat the note as written only when a fresh observation shows the expected title and body. Switching to Notes alone does not complete the writing milestone.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed outcome check; an app activation is not evidence that content was written.
